operations.title: The complete mod-four conductor-Gysin totalization is contractible
operations.body: Because t=p*s*(B-1) pulls all three support faces with unit valuation into the same Tate coefficient, the typed total object is the tensor product of [Z/4 --2--> Z/4] with the augmented three-face simplex. An explicit integral simplex contraction h0=(1,0,0)^T, h1=[[0,1,0],[0,0,0],[0,0,-1]], h2=(0,1,0) induces K(c_p tensor s)=(-1)^p c_p tensor h(s). Exact computation modulo four gives D K+K D=1 on all basis vectors. Hence the local Z/2 conductor grades do not survive complete support totalization.
